issues.detail: make_RackController(subnet=subnet) already sets node.boot_interface to the interface created on the subnet (factory.py make_Node_with_Interface_on_Subnet); .first() only works because interface_count=1 and relies on Interface.Meta.ordering ("created"), so it would silently pick the wrong NIC if a second interface were ever added. Applies to test_discoveries.py:130,143 and test_discovery.py:44,55,80,87.

issues.summary: Extract helper for duplicated pinned-subnet rack setup
issues.detail: The 3-line setup (make_Subnet(cidr="10.0.0.0/8") / make_RackController(subnet=subnet) / grab iface) is now repeated ~6 times across test_discovery.py and test_discoveries.py; a small helper returning (subnet, iface) would cut duplication and document intent. Non-blocking; consistent with existing test style.

issues.summary: Decouple fixture gateway_ip default from the discovery IP
issues.detail: make_Subnet(cidr="10.0.0.0/8") defaults gateway_ip to first+1 = 10.0.0.1 (factory.py:1555-1557), the same address used as the discovered IP in these tests; pre-existing and harmless for current assertions, but gateway_ip=None would remove the coincidence.

The untouched test still gets a random subnet on its interface VLAN; the assertion would break if that random subnet contained 10.0.0.1 (negligible probability). Pinning a subnet and using an IP outside it would make it fully deterministic.
